name: Adventure Day Camp
description_short: A town day camp at the Ridgefield Recreation Center for 4 year olds through children entering grade 7, in one week sessions from 9 am to 4 pm. Groups by grade play sports and games, do art, explore the trails and pond, use the spray area and indoor pool, and older groups go to Martin Park Beach and on field trips.
refund_policy_summary: Refundable up to three weeks before the session starts, with administrative approval and a $25 per week fee; medical absences with a doctor's note refunded pro rata. No refunds for cancelled field trips.
swim_waterfront_notes: Older groups swim in the indoor pool with counselors in the water and lifeguards on duty; weekly swim tests. Grades 2 and up go to Martin Park Beach on Tuesdays. The 4 year olds have outdoor water play only.

sources.note: Researched by Claude from this page. Seven one week sessions June 24 to August 7, Monday to Friday 9 am to 4 pm; groups from preschool 4's to entering grade 7. Before care and after care offered. The page itself shows no year; the handbook linked from it is for summer 2026.

Researched by Claude from this page. Handbook dates: Week 1 June 24 to 26, Week 2 June 29 to July 2 (no camp July 3), then weekly to August 7. Campers must be 4 by September 1, 2026; groups by the grade entering in fall 2026. Bring nut free lunches. Breakfast Bunch 8 to 9 am $45 a week for non-members ($35 members); After Camp Care 4 to 5:30 pm $95 a week. Session prices are the non-member rate; the price for the three day Week 1 is not posted.

Researched by Claude from this page. Non-member rate: $363 a week ($333 members); Week 2 (four days) $308 non-members ($278 members). Field trips included. Members are Ridgefield Recreation Center members. Sibling discount $10 a week.
